name: retro-grid

frames.best_why: The perspective grid and its converging lines read most clearly under the headline here.

tagline: A neon-era grid floor scrolls toward the horizon under a headline.
summary: A synthwave-style perspective floor of thin grid lines that scroll toward the viewer and fade into a glow at the horizon, leaving space above for a headline.
appearance: A dark stage split by a flat horizon, with a perspective grid floor of thin grey lines fanning out to a vanishing point at the horizon. A bright magenta-to-purple headline floats above.
behaviour: The floor scrolls toward the viewer on a slow fifteen-second loop, horizontal lines sliding down and outward while vertical lines fan from the horizon. It freezes when off-screen or when the user prefers reduced motion.
demo_content: The heading reads "Retro Grid" in a pink-purple gradient.
search_phrases: neon grid scene for a hero
use_when: A hero wants an eighties arcade or sci-fi floor behind its headline.
avoid_when: Calm corporate sites: the retro-sci-fi mood is very specific and loud.
customise: Angle, cell size, opacity and separate light and dark line colours are props; scroll speed and perspective are fixed in the shader.
weight_why: A full-screen WebGL fragment shader redrawn every animation frame.

a11y.note: Decorative and pointer-events-none; it freezes when the user prefers reduced motion.

polish_why: Crisp perspective grid with a convincing sense of depth; the scene is sparse by design.
